classic_papers.title: [International Conference on Learning Representations] Spikformer: When Spiking Neural Network Meets Transformer
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首次将脉冲神经网络与Transformer自注意力机制融合，提出脉冲自注意力（SSA），构建Spikformer框架，在ImageNet上实现直接训练SNN的最优性能，开创SNN-Transformer交叉方向。

classic_papers.title: [AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence] Spiking-YOLO: Spiking Neural Network for Energy-Efficient Object Detection
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首个脉冲神经网络目标检测模型。提出通道归一化与带不平衡阈值的符号神经元，实现深度SNN高效信息传递，能耗较Tiny YOLO降低约280倍。

classic_papers.title: [Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition] RMP-SNN: Residual Membrane Potential Neuron for Enabling Deeper High-Accuracy and Low-Latency Spiking Neural Network
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：提出RMP神经元，用软重置保留阈值以上残余膜电位，解决ANN转SNN的硬重置信息损失问题，实现近无损、低延迟深度SNN。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems] DIET-SNN: A Low-Latency Spiking Neural Network With Direct Input Encoding and Leakage and Threshold Optimization
classic_papers.ai_summary: DIET-SNN提出直接输入编码与可学习泄漏/阈值，将SNN推理降至5步，ImageNet达69%且能效超ANN 12倍，显著推动低延迟高效SNN发展。

classic_papers.title: [Nature Communications] A biomimetic neural encoder for spiking neural network
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首次用双栅MoS2 FET实现仿生神经编码器，将模拟信号转为随机脉冲序列，能耗仅1–5 pJ/spike，并完成MNIST快速编码与91%以上SNN推理，为神经形态硬件提供关键传感前端。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence] Fast-SNN: Fast Spiking Neural Network by Converting Quantized ANN
classic_papers.ai_summary: Fast-SNN通过将SNN时间量化等效为ANN空间量化，把量化误差最小化转移至量化ANN训练，并用带符号IF神经元与逐层微调解决累积误差，实现低延迟高性能。

classic_papers.title: [Biomedical Signal Processing and Control] Energy efficient ECG classification with spiking neural network
classic_papers.ai_summary: 提出跨患者心电分类的CNN转SNN方法，精度损失<1%，功耗仅为先前方案的0.74%。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE International Joint Conference on Neural Network] An Efficient Spiking Neural Network for Recognizing Gestures with a DVS Camera on the Loihi Neuromorphic Processor
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首次实现DNN到Loihi SNN的完整转换流程，用于DVS手势识别。核心创新：提出事件相机预处理方法使DvsGesture适配DNN，转换后SNN达89.64%精度，仅占37个Loihi核心。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE transactions on neural systems and rehabilitation engineering] A Spiking Neural Network With Adaptive Graph Convolution and LSTM for EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
classic_papers.ai_summary: 提出自适应图卷积与脉冲LSTM结合的SNN模型SGLNet，有效挖掘EEG通道空间拓扑与脉冲时序依赖，在情绪识别和运动想象任务上超越现有方法。

classic_papers.title: [Neural Networks] An unsupervised STDP-based spiking neural network inspired by biologically plausible learning rules and connections
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首个将无监督STDP-SNN成功应用于CIFAR10的工作。核心创新：融合自适应突触滤波、脉冲阈值与侧抑制三种可塑性机制，并提出STB-STDP加速稳定训练，在MNIST/FashionMNIST达SOTA，小样本下超越同结构监督ANN。

classic_papers.title: [Neural Information Processing Systems] SNN-RAT: Robustness-enhanced Spiking Neural Network through Regularized Adversarial Training
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首个从Lipschitz角度理论刻画SNN对抗脆弱性，并提出低开销正则化对抗训练方案，显著提升鲁棒性。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE International Joint Conference on Neural Network] CarSNN: An Efficient Spiking Neural Network for Event-Based Autonomous Cars on the Loihi Neuromorphic Research Processor
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首个在神经形态芯片上实现事件相机汽车分类的SNN，验证了低延迟低功耗AD感知的可行性。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems] Spiking Neural Network for Ultralow-Latency and High-Accurate Object Detection
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：SUHD通过时间步压缩与STDI编码，实现ANN到SNN无损转换，将检测延迟降低约750倍，mAP提升30%，是当时最深的脉冲目标检测模型。

classic_papers.title: [Neural computing & applications (Print)] Detection of COVID-19 from CT scan images: A spiking neural network-based approach
classic_papers.ai_summary: 该工作将SNN用于COVID-19 CT图像分类，属应用探索而非领域开创。核心创新：用多种深度学习库模拟脉冲神经网络，基于电位模型取得0.99的F1分数，优于多种先进模型，展示了SNN在医学影像分析中的高效潜力。

classic_papers.title: [Neural Networks] BackEISNN: A Deep Spiking Neural Network with Adaptive Self-Feedback and Balanced Excitatory-Inhibitory Neurons
classic_papers.ai_summary: BackEISNN借鉴大脑自突触，提出自适应时延自反馈与兴奋-抑制平衡机制，提升SNN精度与收敛速度，在多个数据集达SOTA。

classic_papers.title: [arXiv.org] A Spiking Neural Network for Image Segmentation
classic_papers.ai_summary: 将U-Net ANN转为SNN，提出基于百分位正则化控制脉冲率，并在Loihi芯片上实现多芯片分区优化，能效超CPU/GPU两倍且精度无损。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE International Joint Conference on Neural Network] CARLsim 6: An Open Source Library for Large-Scale, Biologically Detailed Spiking Neural Network Simulation
classic_papers.ai_summary: CARLsim 6是开源GPU加速SNN仿真平台的重要升级版，支持大规模生物细节建模。核心创新在于新增多种神经调质支持，增强长短时程突触可塑性，推动类脑计算与神经科学研究。

classic_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems] A Bio-Inspired Spiking Attentional Neural Network for Attentional Selection in the Listening Brain
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：首次将脉冲神经网络与注意力机制结合用于听觉注意力解码，实现低延迟下超越传统DNN的脑电解码性能，推动类脑听觉计算发展。

classic_papers.title: [Electronics] Accurate ECG Classification Based on Spiking Neural Network and Attentional Mechanism for Real-Time Implementation on Personal Portable Devices
classic_papers.ai_summary: 提出轻量级SNN+通道注意力ECG分类法，在MIT-BIH达98.26%准确率，实现FPGA低功耗实时部署。

classic_papers.title: [Neural Networks] Sparser spiking activity can be better: Feature Refine-and-Mask spiking neural network for event-based visual recognition
classic_papers.ai_summary: 🔥 领域经典：提出RM-SNN，通过时空与通道维度的Refine-and-Mask模块自适应抑制冗余脉冲，证明更稀疏的脉冲活动反而能提升事件视觉识别性能。

latest_papers.title: [Italian National Conference on Sensors] A Lightweight Keyword Spotting Method Using a Convolutional Spiking Neural Network with Learnable Synaptic Delays
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出轻量级CSNN关键词识别方法，核心突破在于引入可学习突触延迟的延迟感知分类模块，联合优化权重与时序延迟以增强时空证据聚合。模型仅需约6.4万–6.8万参数，在四个数据集上取得92.87%–99.10%的准确率，兼顾紧凑性、精度与噪声鲁棒性。

latest_papers.title: [Frontiers of Physics] Impact of IrOx membrane on HfOx-based capacitor platform integrated with convolutional spiking neural networks for future clinical biomarker diagnostics
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究将IrOx/HfOx EIS生物传感器与CSNN结合，实现H₂O₂（0.5 pM）和尿素（100 pM）超灵敏检测，CSNN分类准确率达95.05%，推动AI驱动临床即时诊断。

latest_papers.title: [2026 IEEE International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Communications Workshops and other Affiliated Events (PerCom Workshops)] An Energy Efficient Convolutional SNN for EEG Analytics towards Wearable BCI Applications
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出轻量级卷积脉冲神经网络CSNN，融合时序卷积与脉冲神经元处理头皮及耳部EEG，支持膜电位与脉冲计数两种读出。在静态与运动条件下，性能接近EEGNet（差距3%内），计算成本降低40–80倍，运动伪影鲁棒性更强，适于可穿戴BCI边缘部署。

latest_papers.title: [Electronics] An Energy- and Endurance-Aware Hybrid CMOS–SDC Memristor Convolutional Spiking Neural Network for Edge Intelligence
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该工作提出混合CMOS–SDC忆阻器CSNN架构，以1-bit CSA比较器替代高精度ADC，并采用强度-延迟单脉冲编码降低写入应力。MNIST达97.8%，读出能耗仅为8-bit ADC方案的18.4%，兼顾能效与耐久性。

latest_papers.title: [International Conference on Computing, Networking and Communications] Energy-Efficient Drowsiness Detection with Spiking Neural Networks
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出基于事件驱动的卷积脉冲神经网络（CSNN）用于驾驶员疲劳检测，在自建眼嘴数据集上以97.94%准确率略超CNN基线（97.79%），同时能耗降低约61%，验证了脉冲计算在资源受限边缘设备上实现实时疲劳监测的潜力。

latest_papers.title: [Bionics of Intelligence] Inference optimization parameters influence spiking neural network efficiency
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究系统探究量化与剪枝初始参数对CSNN效率的影响。基于LIF神经元的卷积SNN在MNIST、FMNIST、CIFAR10上实验表明：低压缩参数下精度损失小且显著降低模型尺寸与能耗；但复杂数据集、次优模型及极端压缩设置下，分类性能急剧恶化。

latest_papers.title: [Nano letters (Print)] One-Step Annealing-Configured Hf0.2Zr0.8O2 Memristive-Antiferroelectric Devices for Bioinspired CSNN Neuromorphic Computing.
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该工作基于同一HZO叠层，通过一步退火分化为忆阻突触与反铁电神经元，构建CMOS兼容CSNN，动态手势识别达97.9%。

latest_papers.title: [2025 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Human-Computer Interaction and Robotics (AIHCIR)] In-Sensor Synchronous Spatial-Temporal Encoding for Spiking Neural Networks on Human Action Recognition
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出传感器内同步时空编码框架，用帧差法将视频实时转为稀疏ON/OFF事件流，替代传统泊松编码，抑制静态背景冗余并降低带宽。基于LIF神经元构建SNN与CSNN，在KTH数据集分别达93.23%和88.37%，显著超越CNN（81.2%）及泊松编码SNN（77.85%），并部署于神经形态视觉处理器，实现超低功耗实时动作识别。

latest_papers.title: [Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Technology] Feature-Optimized Intrusion Detection Based on a Hybrid Spiking Neural Network for the Internet of Things
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出LOA-BHLESNN混合模型，用Lyrebird优化算法选特征、Beta Hebbian学习增强脉冲编码时序精度，在IoT入侵检测三数据集上达99.96%、99.94%、99.81%准确率，优于DPFEN-CTGAN。

latest_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing] LSNN Model: A Lightweight Spiking Neural Network-Based Depression Classification Model for Wearable EEG Sensors
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：LSNNet以仅7.18K参数、67.68M FLOPs的极轻量SNN，在STM32与GAP8微控制器上实现可穿戴EEG抑郁分类，准确率达89.2%，GAP8上功耗仅21.43mW，验证了SNN在边缘神经形态计算中的实用突破。

latest_papers.title: [Nature Communications] A frugal Spiking Neural Network for unsupervised multivariate temporal pattern classification and multichannel spike sorting
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出一种极简单层SNN，无需监督即可在线识别多变量时序模式，并在真实 spike sorting 数据上有效分类动作电位，为超低功耗神经植入硬件铺路。

latest_papers.title: [Global Conference on Consumer Electronics] Real-Time ECG Recognition Using Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks with Sparse Encoding for Arrhythmia Detection
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出Spiking-FusionNet与Spiking-ResNet两种CSNN架构，基于MIT-BIH数据库实现五类心律失常实时检测，F1最高达94.25%。核心突破在于引入稀疏编码、跳跃连接提升训练效率，并用反正切代理梯度解决脉冲不可微问题。

latest_papers.title: [Journal] Fully Integrated Memristive Spiking Neural Network with Analog Neurons for High-Speed Event-Based Data Processing
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该工作实验演示了全集成忆阻SNN，采用128×24忆阻阵列与定制模拟神经元，利用模拟神经元的时间比例缩放特性，仅需紧凑片上电容即可直接训练时空数据。在DVS128手势集上加速5万倍至30微秒，精度93.06%，能效101.05 TSOPS/W，突破了速度、可扩展性与精度瓶颈。

latest_papers.title: [IEEE transactions on circuits and systems for video technology (Print)] Event-Based Video Reconstruction Via Spatial–Temporal Heterogeneous Spiking Neural Network
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该论文提出时空异构脉冲神经元（STH），自适应调节膜衰减系数以匹配事件流异步性，并设计基于傅里叶变换的时频校准模块（TFCM）提升对比度。构建的STHSNN与TFCSNN在SNN类方法中性能居前二，能耗分别降低12.40倍和3.48倍。

latest_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Artificial Intelligence] FPGA-Based Adaptive LIF Neuron for High-Speed, Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Network
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该工作提出基于FPGA的自适应LIF神经元，引入自适应阈值与自适应泄漏率，显著降低发放率与浮点运算。相比最优同类神经元，触发器、LUT与延迟分别优化2.5×、5.7×、2.0×。在MNIST上达95%精度，单图延迟仅0.9ms，能效提升68%。

latest_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems] Advancing Neuromorphic Architecture Toward Emerging Spiking Neural Network on FPGA
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：提出SpikeTA，首个面向Transformer SNN（TSNN）的FPGA神经形态加速器。核心突破：参数化硬件引擎适配异构层、DSP高效加法树、深度感知缓存管理及流式/分引擎数据流映射，实现较CPU/GPU最高1023倍/7.29倍加速，峰值性能28.99 TOPS。

latest_papers.title: [Italian National Conference on Sensors] Balancing Energy Consumption and Detection Accuracy in Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis: A Spiking Neural Network-Based Approach with ECG and PCG Signals
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究提出基于SNN的多模态CVD检测框架，融合ECG与PCG信号，采用差分融合生成EPCG信号，结合ASLT时频特征提取与置信度动态决策融合策略。在PhysioNet 2016数据集上达89.74%准确率，能耗仅209.6 μJ，实现了能耗与精度的有效平衡。

latest_papers.title: [IEEE Symposium on Computational Intelligence in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology] The Brain Watching Itself: Identifying Brain Tumors with Spiking Neural Networks
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究将CSNN用于MRI脑肿瘤分类，对比率编码与时间编码，发现时间编码CSNN达73.10%准确率，媲美传统CNN，同时节省73%内存、推理快13倍，验证了SNN在资源受限临床环境中的高效性与生物合理性。

latest_papers.title: [Nano letters (Print)] Ferroelectric/Antiferroelectric HfZrOx Artificial Synapses/Neurons for Convolutional Neural Network-Spiking Neural Network Neuromorphic Computing.
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：该研究通过元素掺杂调控HfZrOx的铁电/反铁电特性，首次构建铁电人工突触与反铁电人工神经元互补的混合CNN-SNN框架，用于心脏MRI分类，突破纯SNN三维图像识别局限，准确率由纯CNN的82.3%提升至92.7%。

latest_papers.title: [International Conference on Systems] Generating Spiking Neural Network Code Libraries for Embedded Systems
latest_papers.ai_summary: 🆕 最新速递：提出TENNLab嵌入器，将SNN转为无依赖的便携推理代码库，可部署于微控制器等嵌入式冯·诺依曼系统。突破在于无需神经形态硬件即可低SWaP评估SNN，性能媲美手工移植，大幅降低部署门槛。

multi_agent_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Vehicles] UAV Swarm Cooperative Target Search: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：该研究用多智能体强化学习实现无人机群分布式协同搜索，将大规模场景拆分以提供局部与全局信息，并借助卷积神经网络处理高维地图数据，使智能体在未知动态环境中自适应决策，高效协作、避碰去重并更快找到全部目标。

multi_agent_papers.title: [International Journal of Science and Technology Research Archive] Theoretical approaches to AI in supply chain optimization: Pathways to efficiency and resilience
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：本文未涉及SNN，仅泛述群体智能与多智能体系统用于供应链协同，强调分布式协调与博弈决策，缺乏SNN机制分析。

multi_agent_papers.title: [IEEE Access] DermCDSM: Clinical Decision Support Model for Dermatosis Using Systematic Approaches of Machine Learning and Deep Learning
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：本文提出DermCDSM皮肤病临床决策支持模型，采用改进变色龙群优化（ICSO）与多策略寻优（MSSO）进行特征选择，并利用卷积深度脉冲神经网络（CD-SNN）提升多类分类精度，实现分布式协同的智能诊断决策。

multi_agent_papers.title: [Journal of King Saud University: Computer and Information Sciences] A survey on autonomous navigation for mobile robots: From traditional techniques to deep learning and large language models
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：该综述未涉及SNN，仅涵盖传统、群智能（PSO/ACO）与LLM导航。群智通过分布式个体交互涌现路径决策，LLM则实现语言到动作的协同，但SNN在交互协同决策中的作用未被讨论。

multi_agent_papers.title: [IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing] Symmetry-Informed MARL: A Decentralized and Cooperative UAV Swarm Control Approach for Communication Coverage
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：该研究将UAV群通信覆盖建模为对称性约束的Dec-POMDP，提出SiGNN嵌入空间旋转对称性于策略/价值网络，实现分布式协同决策，提升样本效率与大规模群扩展性。

multi_agent_papers.title: [International Journal of Communication Systems] AI‐Enabled Zero Trust Model for Cyberattack Mitigation in Decentralized 6G Network
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：SNN用于资源受限边缘节点的快速低功耗攻击缓解，配合多智能体强化学习实现分布式节点独立又协同的威胁响应决策。

multi_agent_papers.title: [IEEE transactions on computers] JCSRC: Joint Client Selection and Resource Configuration for Energy-Efficient Multi-Task Federated Learning
multi_agent_papers.ai_summary: 🐝 群智决策：本文提出JCSRC，用MARL做客户端选择、PSO做资源分配，联合优化多任务联邦学习的能效。SNN未涉及，核心是群智协同决策。

multi_agent_papers.title: [Drones] Variations in Multi-Agent Actor–Critic Frameworks for Joint Optimizations in UAV Swarm Networks: Recent Evolution, Challenges, and Directions
